chronicle.text: Among the Kaqkushi, people begin to sow wheat and barley and keep sheep and goats.
Among the Fetonke, people begin to sow yams and taro and keep pigs and fowl.
Among the Dadzakhites, people begin to sow yams and taro and keep pigs and fowl.
Among the Datikites, people begin to sow rice and keep pigs and water buffalo.
The Dadzakhans build boats that can cross open sea.
Smiths among the Fetonke learn to smelt copper, and later bronze.
